## Summary

A fully-specified mechanical **NQ intraday long** system, self-reported backtest Jan 2018 → Nov 2026, strategy named **"Breasthook_20min_NQ"** on the stats card (OCR-read). Every entry rule is in the tweet text — nothing is image-gated:

- **Instrument/bars:** NQ futures, 20-minute bars. **Long only.**
- **Day filter:** the session must OPEN above yesterday's RTH high (gap-up open). No gap-up open → no trade that day.
- **Setup:** mark the first 45 minutes' range (initial balance). Entry = a 20-min bar CLOSE 2 points above that range high, while price is above the 80 EMA.
- **Exits:** fixed stop and fixed target, both 1 ATR. "That's the entry" — no trailing, no discretion.

**The numbers** (stats card via OCR, cross-validated against tweet text where they overlap):

- Net **$288,817** over **361 trades** since January 2018, net of **$2.18/side commissions + 2 ticks slippage per fill** (tweet: "commissions and slippage in").
- **Profit factor 1.43 · win rate 60.9%** (tweet rounds to 61%) · Sharpe **1.03** · Sortino 1.53 · return 577.6% · Calmar **0.59**.
- **Max drawdown −$48,663 (−41.2%)** — the return/Calmar pair says the curve earned its money through a deep hole.
- **Avg win $4,374.50 vs avg loss −$4,777.11** — payoff ratio <1; expectancy $800.05/trade. Sanity check: 0.609 × 4,374.50 − 0.391 × 4,777.11 = $796 ≈ $800 ✓ — the card is internally consistent, not pasted-together.
- Streaks: 9 consecutive wins max, 7 consecutive losses max.
- Consistency: **62% green weeks** (avg $1,250, worst −$18,952), **68% green months** (avg $2,860, worst −$29,452); best week ~$13.6k, best month $17,243 (a $43,980 figure also sits on the card — likely best-month or a period aggregate; OCR layout ambiguous, unverified).
- ~361 trades over ~8.9 years ≈ **40 trades/year** — consistent with the gap-up-day filter doing real work (few qualifying days, not all trigger).

**Author's own framing, unusually honest:** "avg loss is $4,777 vs $4,374 for the avg win, so **it lives off that win rate**"; "runs all the way to November 2026 and **you can see this year giving some back**"; and "**grab the code and see for yourself**" — code is "free in my discord" (join-gated).

## Why it matters

- **The rarest capture class: a fully-specified NQ system in plain text.** The only prior mechanical-NQ capture in the vault ([[2026-09-27-milk-man-nq-scalping-algo-v0]]) locked its logic in a screenshot and an NT8 dependency. This one's five rules are complete in the tweet itself — filter, range, trigger buffer, regime gate, ATR exits — so it can be re-backtested without joining anything. The Discord "free code" is a funnel, not a dependency.
- **Gap-conditioned index trading is an established vault lineage, and this is the continuation side of it.** [[2026-11-02-0xarchive-btc-sp500-gap-fade]] captures the gap-FADE school (bet the gap closes); this is the gap-CONTINUATION school (gap up, buy the breakout of the opening range). Same conditioning event, opposite sign — the pair brackets the question "do NQ gap-ups extend or fill?", and both notes' caveats (regime dependence, sparse samples) rhyme.
- **The risk profile is a high-win-rate grinder with a fat left tail, and the author says so.** Payoff <1 + 60.9% WR + −41.2% max DD on a 1.03 Sharpe: this is not a smooth compounder, it's a win-rate-dependent system whose worst stretch halved the account. "This year giving some back" is an author-admitted 2026 decay — the same by-year decay signature flagged in [[2026-11-09-zenomtrader-verified-only-costs-sharpe]] and the Astraeus teardown, and the exact regime-sensitivity the Milk Man pre-flagged on his own NQ v0.
- **Costs are modeled, which sets it above most card-tweets** — $2.18/side + 2 ticks slippage is the costs-in discipline of the ZenomTrader school, not the gross-PF card style. But one cost the card can't model: ~1 trade every 6 trading days means position sizing per trade is necessarily large relative to equity to produce a $288k net — the −41.2% DD is the tell.
- **Skepticism gates:** anonymous author, zero prior captures, self-reported backtest with no OOS/walk-forward split disclosed; stats recovered by OCR from an image (headline numbers cross-validate against the text, peripheral ones — Sortino, streaks, monthly bests — are single-source OCR); 361 trades is a thin sample for a 5-parameter system; Discord funnel (the card is the ad); 2026 giveback is author-confirmed; engagement (23 likes / 1.4k views) means essentially nobody has scrutinized it — no crowding, but also no due diligence by proxy. Interesting, not believed until re-run.
- **For the user:** filed as reference-plus-task. The replication is cheap (rules are complete, NQ daily/20-min data is on hand) — the task is to re-backtest before treating the card as evidence, per [[2026-08-29-milk-man-replication-metrics]].
